subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical generated-media completion tracker, or should maintainers split the remaining wake-false, output-contract, and cron-context mechanisms into narrower canonical items now?
rationale: Current source and discussion show multiple partially overlapping delivery-policy mechanisms, and choosing the canonical tracking shape affects whether open PRs like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97275 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101078 are reviewed as partial fixes or complete closure paths.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical parent until the focused fixes land or the unresolved mechanisms are explicitly split with links.

options.title: Split then narrow
options.body: Open or designate separate canonical items for wake-false delivery, output-contract media loss, and cron context, then close this only after those links preserve the context.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this in favor of existing narrower items, accepting the risk that some cross-mechanism discussion and release evidence becomes harder to find.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical parent until the focused fixes land or the unresolved mechanisms are explicitly split with links.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared async media-generation path and already provided the reopen/scope note for the remaining mechanisms.
